set.body:
Outcome
Complete ordinary native control recipes from the accepted baseline.

Owned scope
meridian-theme action/form/feedback recipes; sampler component fixture

Prerequisites
B3

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Cover buttons, toggle buttons, check/radio controls, text/password/text-area inputs, spinner, slider, progress and validation feedback using standard JavaFX or suitable existing AtlantaFX controls.
- [ ] Verify default/hover/pressed/focus/disabled and applicable invalid/read-only/indeterminate/selected combinations; selected or invalid controls retain visible keyboard focus.
- [ ] Native regular/strong font faces, alignment and icon optical weight are documented and measured; 125/150/200% text scaling grows controls or makes content scrollable.
- [ ] Validation uses persistent label/error text and accessible associations; no meaning depends only on color. Default 12/13/14 px text roles are honored.
- [ ] Compact mode changes spacing without shrinking essential typography; controls allow localization and multiline content.

Required evidence
Native computed geometry/paint tests, four variant state fixture, long-label/enlarged-text captures and validation associations.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code C1. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [C1] Complete action, form, feedback and typography recipes
